column1: # Stage S10 H1b, the feature crate: a mission's review record (the history and thread views, the
# comment composer, the artifact provenance, the submission control with its refusal panel and the
# wording they share) becomes crates/frontend/features/mission_review_record. The folder becomes
# the crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README. With it the
# app's foundation and features folders are empty: their READMEs become the READMEs of the
# category folders that now hold those layers, crates/frontend/foundation and
# crates/frontend/features. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder and one
# `mission_review_record::` row scoped to the app's source.
